notes: All 8 searches used. 21 fetches used. Region: Ohio and Michigan. The known Newark Digimon regional was skipped as already known. Greenie Sports Cards shows were skipped per brief, including Medina Oct 31, Great Northern in North Olmsted Nov 6 to 7, the Kirtland shows, the Broadview Heights Dec 19 show and the Ohio State Card Show at Kasich Hall. treasurehunter.show and thecardshopfinder.com are on the never-fetch list, so their search snippets were used only as leads and their pages were not fetched. Detroit Sports Spectacular: the organizer's own pages were read. Its trade night date reads Saturday May 30 but that date is a Sunday in 2027, and its vendor deadlines are dated 2026, so neither is recorded. The Findlay Card Show, Emidio and Akron 500 expo pages, Syndicate Trade Show and Detroit Card Show venue calendar were read directly. Most Ohio editions with agent_confidence medium come from one aggregator, allohiocardshows.com, and are not corroborated by an organizer page. Its listings with hours flagged 'verify' had hours omitted. Emidio dates Dec 14 and Dec 15, 2027 were flagged as weekday mismatches and excluded. The Emidio organizer homepage and events page disagree on December 2027, so those were not recorded. localcardshows.org lists dates without years, so its Michigan entries are leads only, except The Livonia Show whose detail page shows the year. cardshowatlas.com was too large: only the first 100,000 characters were read. The AOL CARDhio article returned 404. No phone numbers were recorded. Organizer contact emails recorded are the ones published for vendors: info@syndicatetradeshow.com, Info@findlaycardshow.com and chicagoshowvendors@gmail.com. Collector's Arena dates are unresolved between listing sites and its own site, which lists no dates.
